test_title: PYST 158: SSC GD Constable - GA & GK (Held On - 07 Feb, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: SAMADHAN portal allows online registration with the intent to make justice for workmen simple and quick. Industrial dispute is raised before _____ of the area.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Conciliation Officer.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option is the** Conciliation Officer.**__
 
• **SAMADHAN portal is an online platform for registration of industrial disputes that aims to simplify and expedite the process of obtaining justice for workmen.**
 
• A conciliation officer is an official appointed by the government to mediate and resolve disputes between employers and employees, as per the** Industrial Disputes Act, 1947.**
 
• The conciliation officer is responsible for facilitating negotiations between the parties involved in the dispute and attempting to reach an amicable settlement.
 
• The other options, such as Block Development Officer and Circle Inspector, are not relevant to the resolution of industrial disputes and do not have the requisite authority or expertise to mediate between employers and employees. Custom Officer is also not relevant in this context.
